sources.title: MageFlow Edit GGUF Pipeline - GitHub
sources.snippet: An enterprise-grade, high-performance instruction-based image editing pipeline powered by the Mage-Flow-Edit GGUF 4-step Turbo model (mageflow-edit-turbo-nvfp4.gguf, 2.37 GB) and Ollama (llama3.2:3b). This pipeline transforms reference images based on natural language editing instructions, such as applying golden-hour sunset lighting and autumn environment shifts with native-resolution fidelity.
